title: The Flooded Gallery
text: The lower gallery is flooded to the waist, the water black and still and very cold. Pillars rise out of it like drowned trees. Something gleams under the surface a long way in, gold or glass or an eye.

options.label: Wade through the black water, and do not reach for whatever gleams.

outcomes.text: You come through, wet and cold to the bone.
The gleam was something in the water, and it was looking at you.

options.label: The toughest dives for the gleam, holding their breath against the cold.

outcomes.text: They find a drowned miner's lamp and purse. The miner does not mind; he watches them go.

options.label: Find a way around, rather than wade into water that black.

outcomes.text: The way around is longer and drier, but not empty.
